statement: Use lawful open-source software, repositories, algorithms, public technical information and reusable mechanisms as a default engineering supply chain for completing the currently achievable GREG Body + Organs + Mind; invent only the residual capability that verified reuse, adaptation and composition cannot supply.
owner: Alfonso Lopez; repository maintainers and coding agents implement
binding_scope: Project-wide development and implementation selection across Kernel, Cortex, organs, Foundry, capability genesis and future bodies. It governs how missing capabilities are sourced; it does not itself authorize installation, activation, deployment or external effects.
constitutional_constraints: Alfonso remains root human constitutional authority
Imported or generated capability never inherits authority
License, attribution, model/data terms, patents, provenance and security must be checked before code reuse
Educational or example code is not represented as production-qualified without independent tests and a stronger-baseline comparison
No automatic paid fallback, unapproved download, runtime self-installation, self-attachment or live promotion
One canonical GREG path and one authority spine remain controlling
Open-source reuse is an acceleration strategy, not a stopping condition that narrows the full-machine destination
success_evidence: Material CapabilityDeficits record existing/internal and open-source candidates before custom architecture
Adopted code or dependencies retain upstream repository, commit/tag, path/package, exact license/notice obligations and replacement interface
Imported mechanisms pass native qualification, project integration tests and consequence-appropriate verification
Repository-scale imports are replaced by narrow adapters or vendored slices when those preserve the effect with less coupling
Foundry work identifies the residual novel mechanism after reuse options are exhausted
failure_evidence: Rebuilding mature commodity mechanisms without documenting why available open-source routes fail
Treating an educational implementation, stars or popularity as production qualification
Importing large repositories that create duplicate authority, registries, schedulers, learning planes or unbounded dependency burden
Declaring the mind complete because a mechanism catalog exists
dependencies: Existing Capability Genome and CapabilityDeficit handling
Canonical GREG mission and authority path
Mechanism Recombination Foundry for residual invention
Repository/source diligence, security review and license verification
Typed adapters, tests, receipts and rollback for adopted mechanisms
conflicts: The founder's colloquial 'copy and paste' wording cannot override upstream license, notice, security, privacy, patent or distribution obligations
Some open-source projects are educational, research-only, copyleft, source-available, model-license-restricted, abandoned or operationally heavier than a small local implementation
Open source can eliminate license/API cost without eliminating hardware, electricity, storage, maintenance, exclusive data or platform fees
next_review_trigger: Every new material CapabilityDeficit and every proposed repository-scale import; re-evaluate source fitness when upstream license, maintenance, security posture, API, model weights or project requirements change.
supersedes: Any narrow interpretation of INTENT-20260930-open-source-first that limits reuse to replacing paid AI/provider costs
Any default build behavior that writes a new implementation before checking mature reusable mechanisms
